message: I’ve had my fair share of unexpected blackouts, and it’s always a surprise how quickly things can go dark—especially when you’re in the middle of a binge-watching marathon or trying to finish a last-minute project! This resource from Ready.gov is super handy for planning ahead and keeping your cool when the power goes out. Remember, a little prep can go a long way in making those moments a lot less stressful. What’s your go-to tip for dealing with blackouts? 💡
